name: BC5 Compression
definition: BC5 is a block compression format for 2-channel (RG) textures, compressing 4x4 blocks (32 bytes) into 16 bytes. It supports two variants: BC5_UNORM (outputs [0, 1] floats) and BC5_SNORM (outputs [-1, 1] floats).
summary: BC5 Compression is a block compression format for 2-channel textures that halves data size by encoding 4x4 blocks into 16 bytes using min-max endpoints and 3-bit indices.
